Here is an approach for this cell.

```python
"""Momentum over ``lookback`` bars: long (+1) for the next bar when the last
close is above the close ``lookback`` bars before it, short (-1) otherwise,
flat (0) while the slice is shorter. With ``lookback`` 215 it makes exactly
30 position changes on ``test_synth``'s W of 2019-07-15, summed over the
basket, none of its instruments making 30 alone (DESIGN 12.2 stage 4, R-1;
decision 2026-10-14-m12 98 (b)). A fixture of
``tests/test_validation_sequence.py``.
"""

PARAMS = {"lookback": 215}


def position(bars, params):
    close = bars["close"].to_numpy()
    k = int(params["lookback"])
    if len(close) < k + 1:
        return 0.0
    if close[-1] > close[-1 - k]:
        return 1.0
    return -1.0
```
Momentum over a fixed lookback: long when the last close is above the close that many bars before, short otherwise.
